question.text: An ellipse has $\mathrm{OB}$ as semi minor axis, $\mathrm{F}$ and $\mathrm{F}^{\prime}$ its focii and the angle FBF' is a right angle. Then the eccentricity of the ellipse is

solution.text: $$ \begin{aligned} & \because \angle \text { FBF }^{\prime}=90^{\circ} \\ & \therefore\left(\sqrt{a^2 e^2+b^2}\right)^2+\left(\sqrt{a^2 e^2+b^2}\right)^2=(2 a \mathrm{e})^2 \\ & \Rightarrow 2\left(a^2 e^2+b^2\right)=4 a^2 e^2 \\ & \Rightarrow \mathrm{e}^2=\mathrm{b}^2 / \mathrm{a}^2 \\ & \text { Also } \mathrm{e}^2=1-\mathrm{b}^2 / \mathrm{a}^2=1-\mathrm{e}^2 \\ & \Rightarrow 2 \mathrm{e}^2=1, \mathrm{e}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} . \end{aligned} $$
